tr.title: SEC, Cboe 3x Bitcoin ve Ethereum ETF Teklifine Yorum Sürecini Açtı
slides: SEC, Cboe 3x Bitcoin ve Ethereum ETF'yi inceler.
İçerik, 3 katlı kaldıraçlı kripto birimlerini kapsar.

en.title: SEC Opens Comment Period on Cboe 3x Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF Proposal
slides: SEC begins review of Cboe 3x Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF.
The proposal covers triple‑leverage Bitcoin and Ethereum.
Investors should study the application and risks.
en.caption:
SEC has begun reviewing Cboe's 3x Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF proposal. The comment period opens on February 2, 2026. The product carries additional risks for investors.
